main_claim: Analyst Álvaro Colmenero reports that Topuria will return to public life in September after almost three months out of sight.
quote: sé que Ilia regresará a la luz pública durante este mes de septiembre
note: A named analyst states as fact that he is coming back into public after time away; the June loss and fractures are background. No fight is mentioned.

main_claim: Donchenko beat Punahele Soriano by unanimous decision in Paris, his fourth UFC win.
quote: завершився перемогою українця одностайним рішенням суддів: 30–27, 30–27, 29–28
note: A fight report; nothing about a next fight.

main_claim: Topuria's manager Malki Kawa says they want an immediate rematch with Gaethje.
quote: Malki Kawa dejó un mensaje claro y directo: «Nosotros queremos esta pelea»
note: A manager's wish is no_fact by the guide. Unsure on fact because the writer also says he has recovered from the surface wounds and gone back to Miami, which an editor could read as a status update, but it is the writer's own inference from photos, not a named statement.

main_claim: Dana White says Topuria is ready to return and the UFC is undecided between Gaethje and Pimblett as his next opponent.
quote: Dana White -jefe de la UFC- ha dicho que el peleador hispanogeorgiano está listo para volver, aunque tienen un gran dilema a la hora de elegir quién será su siguiente rival
note: The promotion states he is ready and names two opponents only as options, with nothing set: status_update, not next_fight.

main_claim: Donchenko tells how little he earned early in his career, including 1,500 hryvnias per win in a Kyiv restaurant club.
quote: Платили тисячу гривень за вихід і півтори — за перемогу
note: He himself talks about money and his family's reaction, which the guide puts under personal_life. Unsure on fact because it is old career history told in an interview, which an editor could call no_fact. The 5 September fight is a closing background line, so next fight is no.

main_claim: Donchenko fights Punahele Soriano tonight on the UFC Paris main card; start times and where to watch.
quote: Донченко та Соріано вийдуть в октагон орієнтовно о 23:00 за київським часом
note: A watch-live piece: card order, start times and broadcast. The booking is only the premise, so next fight is no.

main_claim: Topuria's conditioning coach Jesús Gallo says his recovery is going excellently and he could be physically ready by December, though 2027 is the sensible target.
quote: "La recuperación ha sido estupenda, y hay que darle un crédito increíble a los doctores que han estado trabajando con él en España"
note: A named member of his team states how the recovery is going; the same statement also gives a return window, which the guide keeps under health. No specific fight; date and opponent are said to be unknown.

main_claim: Topuria is doing well and close to recovered, per his friend Merab Dvalishvili and his coach Jesús Gallo, with a return seen at the end of the year or more likely early 2027.
quote: Gallo reconoció además que la progresión de Topuria es positiva y que, si todo continúa como hasta ahora, podría alcanzar el nivel físico requerido para competir antes de que acabe 2026
note: Named people state his condition and recovery, so health. Unsure on fact because the headline and Dvalishvili's words are about his return window and general state, which could be status_update, and Gallo's interview is from some weeks earlier. Opponents are named only as possibilities.

main_claim: There are rumours of a Topuria vs Pimblett fight in December, voiced by coach Tim Welch on Sean O'Malley's podcast, and O'Malley leans towards Pimblett.
quote: "Hay rumores de un Paddy Pimblett contra Topuria en diciembre", ha apuntado Tim Welch en el podcast de Sean O'Malley
note: The rumour has substance (who said it, the month), and Pimblett says nobody has spoken to him, so next_fight at rumour. Unsure because much of the piece is Pimblett's wish and O'Malley's pick, which an editor could weigh as the main claim and call no_fact.

main_claim: Donchenko's next fight is set: he faces Punahele Soriano on 5 September at UFC Fight Night in Paris.
quote: Наступний поєдинок 24-річного представника напівсередньої ваги відбудеться 5 вересня на турнірі UFC Fight Night, який прийматиме Париж
note: A booking announcement with date, event and opponent, stated as settled.

main_claim: Dana White says Topuria is ready to fight, nothing is set, and Gaethje and Pimblett are both good options for his next opponent.
quote: "Topuria's ready to fight. We're ready for him," White said ... "We don't have anything set."
note: The promotion says he is ready, nothing is booked and two opponents are options with no talks: status_update by the guide. The leaked rematch idea is a background line.

main_claim: Dan Hooker says Topuria would not take the risk of fighting an unranked Usman Nurmagomedov.
quote: ¿Creen que Ilia va a correr el riesgo de pelear contra un tipo no rankeado que ni siquiera es de la UFC?
note: Another fighter's opinion about a hypothetical matchup; no new fact about Topuria.

main_claim: Topuria has returned to social media for the first time since his June loss, with a video letter to his son about what the defeat taught him.
quote: Ilia Topuria has returned to social media for the first time since his stoppage loss to Justin Gaethje at UFC White House in June.
note: He is back in public after time away, by his own act, and no return timetable is set. Unsure on fact because the content is a reflection addressed to his son (could be personal_life or no_fact), and one line cites MMA Fighting on his facial injuries needing no surgery (could be health). The rematch 'on the table' is only an option.

main_claim: Donchenko beat Punahele Soriano by unanimous decision on the UFC Paris main card.
quote: Daniil Donchenko def. Punahele Soriano via unanimous decision (30-27 x2, 29-28)
note: His bout on a results page.

main_claim: Paddy Pimblett says he would love to fight Topuria but there have been no official talks.
quote: "I'd love to smash his head in, lad, but we'll need to wait and see," ... "Nothing yet. No one's spoke to me about it"
note: A callout and a wish, with no talks: no_fact. Unsure because the piece also mentions 'growing chatter' that the UFC is considering an immediate Gaethje rematch; it gives no who, when or where, so I treated it as framing, but an editor could call it a rumoured next fight.

main_claim: Alexandre Pantoja sent Topuria a message of support after his public reappearance.
quote: "¡Todavía tenemos mucho por conquistar!", escribió el brasileño
note: A message of support is not a fact about him. The injuries are a recap and the Anik rematch rumour is recalled in the closing lines, so both are background.

main_claim: Brendan Schaub names Amosov as the nightmare matchup the UFC could give Ian Machado Garry to make his road back harder.
quote: Schaub believes that if they book him to fight Machado Garry, this will prove that the promotion is no longer interested in the Irishman.
note: A former fighter's speculation about a possible booking; no rumour, talks or fact about Amosov.

main_claim: UFC commentator Jon Anik says there are internal conversations at the UFC about an immediate Gaethje vs Topuria rematch.
quote: "I think there are internal conversations to potentially try to do Gaethje vs. Topuria 2," Anik said
note: A third party reports talks about a specific fight: next_fight. Unsure on firmness: 'internal conversations' fits rumour, but a named person stating it could be read as reported; Anik himself calls part of it 'non-informed speculation'.

main_claim: Jon Anik says the UFC is having internal conversations about a Gaethje vs Topuria rematch.
quote: “I think there are internal conversations to potentially try to do Gaethje vs. Topuria 2,” the UFC commentator said.
note: A third party reports talks about a specific fight: next_fight. Unsure on firmness for the same reason as the other Anik piece: 'internal conversations' is rumour wording, but it comes from a named person, which could be reported.

main_claim: Teammate Jorge Masvidal says Amosov is a bad matchup for everyone, Makhachev included, and will be a future UFC welterweight champion.
quote: "He's a bad fight for everybody. Even Makhachev, all the way down to No. 10, Yaroslav is that good."
note: An assessment and a prediction only; his past wins are background and 'due for a big fight' is the writer's opinion.
